title: English for Banking and Finance – in English

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop advanced English language skills in the context of banking and finance, including listening, speaking, reading, and writing.
Understand the structure, functions, and roles of financial systems and institutions.
Understand and apply risk management strategies in banking operations.
Analyze the characteristics, functions, and operations of financial markets and instruments.
Demonstrate effective teamwork and collaboration in group projects.
Apply critical thinking skills to analyze financial activities and solve practical problems.
Understand and demonstrate ethical responsibility and social accountability in professional contexts.

prerequisite_courses: Integrated Practice - English for Economics and Business 2
